content:
alba-support: Heads-up — support rep tried to apply 100 trial credits to acct acct_123 via Support Console at ~11:12 UTC. UI showed success toast but ledger shows no grant and customer still on trial. Seen for 3 customers in last hour. Repro steps below.

ben-backoffice: Can you paste the exact payload + response from the console request?

alba-support: Copying from browser/network: 
```
POST /internal/support/grants HTTP/1.1
Host: backoffice.internal
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "account_id": "acct_123",
  "amount": 100,
  "currency": "USD",
  "op_id": "op_987"
}
Response: 200 OK
{ "status": "enqueued", "operation_id": "op_987" }
```

alba-support: console shows success because backend returned 200 (enqueued). But ledger table has no row for op_987 and user did not receive credits.

charlie-eng: Looking at queue metrics — the grants consumer crashed intermittently around 11:13 with DB errors: "could not serialize access due to concurrent update" and then restarted. It seems some ops remained in the queue in `enqueued` state and never reconciled.

dana-payments: If we re-run the grant will it double-credit? are ops idempotent by op_id? :thinking_face:

charlie-eng: Grants are supposed to be idempotent keyed by `operation_id`, but the support-console currently does NOT include an `Idempotency-Key` header and sometimes generates duplicate ephemeral op ids client-side. If the consumer never persisted a marker before failing, retries can be ambiguous.

support-bot: consumer-grants: restarted grants-consumer-02 at 1768432200. Requeued 3 messages from dead consumer.

charlie-eng: After restart, 2 of 3 ops processed successfully and wrote ledger rows. op_987 failed due to FK constraint (account row missing?) — digging.

alba-support: op_987 is for acct_123 — account exists and is active. I can DM the account id if helpful.

eli-support: Manual reconcile steps I used last time (use with caution):
1) Query the pending op: `SELECT id, op_id, payload, status FROM support_grants WHERE op_id='op_987'`
2) If no ledger row: `curl -X POST "https://backoffice.internal/internal/grants/complete" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"op_id":"op_987","ledger_tx":"manual-2026-03-17-01"}'`
3) Verify ledger entry: `SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE reference_op='op_987'`
Do NOT run the API if there's an existing ledger row — you'll duplicate.

charlie-eng: Good catch. For op_987 the consumer logged: `ERROR: insert into ledger failed: insert on table "ledger" violates foreign key constraint "ledger_account_fk"` — which means the consumer attempted to write a ledger row referencing account id that our ledger db didn't see due to cross-db replication lag in the maintenance window. So the insert failed and we left the op as enqueued.

dana-payments: So root cause is cross-db replication timing + consumer crash on transient error -> enqueued ops never reconciled. What's the mitigation?

charlie-eng: Short term: run the reconcile endpoint for enqueued ops once replication is fully caught up. I'll add a one-off job to reprocess `enqueued` ops after verifying replication state. Long term: (1) support-console must set `Idempotency-Key` and surface `operation_id` in UI, (2) consumer should mark ops persistent before attempting ledger write or use transactional retry with backoff, (3) alert when `enqueued` > 5 for > 10m.

ben-backoffice: I can add a temporary admin page to list all `enqueued` grants for manual reconcile and to expose op_id so support can see the authoritative op id.

support-bot: reconcile-job: started at 1768432320, reprocessing enqueued grants (3 total). Results: 2 applied, 1 failed (op_987).

eli-support: For op_987 I ran the manual `complete` after confirm that account row exists in ledger DB and it succeeded — customer credited. Steps I followed above.

alba-support: Thanks — I'll update the affected customers. Please ping when the console patch is in staging so we can validate idempotency header is present.

charlie-eng: ETA for console patch -> staging in ~90m, prod deploy after verification ~3h. I'll post PR + changelog. Also adding dashboard alert for `enqueued` > 5.

dana-payments: Keep me in the loop re: refunds or notes needed for billing.

alba-support: Will do. Thanks all :raised_hands:
